name: Sloth
description: Hot reload for TeamCode: deploys changed OpMode code in seconds without reinstalling the Robot Controller app.

artifacts.description: Sloth runtime, installed with the Robot Controller app
Gradle plugin that adds the deploySloth and removeSlothRemote tasks

postInstall: Do one full install (FTC: Full Install) before the first hot reload; FTC Core enforces this.

Only classes in org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode and its subpackages are hot reloaded. Changes to libraries, resources or @Pinned classes need a full install; FTC Core detects these and switches automatically.

conflicts.reason: Remove Dairy Util; Dairy Core includes Sloth instead (see the Sloth README).
Remove Sinister; Dairy Core includes Sloth instead (see the Sloth README).
The standard FTC Dashboard does not work with Sloth; use the Sloth-compatible FTC Dashboard (slothboard).

verification.notes: Task names verified from the Load 0.3.2 plugin classes (dexSloth, assembleSloth, deploySloth, removeSlothRemote).
